title: Grammar: The Verb 'Hacer'
description: Deep practice of 'hacer': the weather, everyday activities, and saying how long things have been happening.

sentences.spanish: Hoy hace buen tiempo.
sentences.english: The weather is nice today.

sentences.spanish: En invierno hace mucho frío en Burgos.
sentences.english: In winter it's very cold in Burgos.

sentences.spanish: En Sevilla hace calor en agosto.
sentences.english: It's hot in Seville in August.

sentences.spanish: Hoy hace viento en la costa.
sentences.english: It's windy on the coast today.

sentences.spanish: ¿Qué tiempo hace en tu ciudad?
sentences.english: What's the weather like in your city?

sentences.spanish: Hace sol, vamos a la terraza.
sentences.english: It's sunny, let's go out to the terrace.

sentences.spanish: En primavera hace fresco por la mañana.
sentences.english: In spring it's cool in the morning.

sentences.spanish: ¿Qué haces los fines de semana?
sentences.english: What do you do at weekends?

sentences.spanish: Hago deporte tres veces por semana.
sentences.english: I do sport three times a week.

sentences.spanish: Mi hermana hace la cena todas las noches.
sentences.english: My sister makes dinner every night.

sentences.spanish: Hago la compra los sábados.
sentences.english: I do the shopping on Saturdays.

sentences.spanish: ¿Hacemos una paella el domingo?
sentences.english: Shall we make a paella on Sunday?

sentences.spanish: Los niños hacen los deberes después de merendar.
sentences.english: The children do their homework after their afternoon snack.

sentences.spanish: Hago fotos de todo el viaje.
sentences.english: I take photos of the whole trip.

sentences.spanish: Hace dos años que vivo aquí.
sentences.english: I've been living here for two years.

sentences.spanish: ¿Cuánto tiempo hace que vives en Valencia?
sentences.english: How long have you lived in Valencia?

sentences.spanish: Hace diez minutos que espero el autobús.
sentences.english: I've been waiting for the bus for ten minutes.

sentences.spanish: Hace mucho que no te veía.
sentences.english: Long time no see!

sentences.spanish: Hace un mes que no llueve.
sentences.english: It hasn't rained for a month.

sentences.spanish: Hace frío, cierra la ventana, por favor.
sentences.english: It's cold, close the window, please.

sentences.spanish: Los fines de semana hago senderismo.
sentences.english: At weekends I go hiking.

sentences.spanish: Hago cola cada mañana para el metro.
sentences.english: I queue every morning for the metro.

sentences.spanish: ¿Quién hace la reserva del restaurante?
sentences.english: Who's making the restaurant booking?

sentences.spanish: Este verano hacemos un viaje al norte.
sentences.english: This summer we're taking a trip up north.

sentences.spanish: Mi padre desayuna café y hace un crucigrama.
sentences.english: My dad has coffee and does a crossword.

sentences.spanish: Hago lo que puedo.
sentences.english: I do what I can.

sentences.spanish: Mi madre hace bizcocho los domingos.
sentences.english: My mum bakes a cake on Sundays.

grammarExplanation:
'Hacer' means 'to do' or 'to make', but it also covers things English splits across other verbs:

• Weather → hace sol / frío / calor / viento / buen tiempo = it's sunny / cold / hot / windy / nice
• Time elapsed → Hace + time + que + present = how long something has been happening: Hace dos años que vivo aquí.

Everyday expressions:
• hacer la compra = to do the shopping
• hacer fotos = to take photos
• hacer deporte = to do sport
• hacer cola = to queue

Conjugation:
• Hago = I do (IRREGULAR!)
• Haces = you do
• Hace = he/she does
• Hacemos = we do
• Hacéis = you all do
• Hacen = they do

senderismo.mnemonic: Send your legs up the sendero (path).
senderismo.explanation: Hillwalking / hiking, hugely popular in Spain.
